arguments.prompt: Nine inventory icons for a moody adventure game, arranged as a 3 by 3 grid of equal square cells on one picture: in every cell one object centred and filling most of the cell, softly lit from the upper left, painterly realistic style, plain dark warm-grey cloth background with a faint vignette, the same background and the same scale in every cell (every object drawn at the same icon size, as large as the cell allows with a margin), no borders, frames or lines between the cells, nothing crossing a cell edge, exactly one object or one small group per cell, no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere, not even on the objects. Everyday goods of a 1970s-80s Soviet seaside town, no real brands. Row 2, left: a worn cloth-bound book with a faded red cover showing an embossed sailing ship, no title, pages dog-eared.
